rejection_reason: Session range breakouts on EURUSD M15 suffer from severe mean-reverting chop and retail stop hunts during London/NY overlap, producing negative expectancy (PF 0.844) across all parameter combinations.

negative_knowledge_catalog.finding: Gold and EURUSD possess opposite microstructure behaviors on session breakouts: Gold trend-expands (Strategy 42, PF 1.817), whereas EURUSD mean-reverts. Breakout trading on EURUSD M15 is mathematically destructive.
